content:
Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) conducted recruitment for Stenographer posts under Advertisement No. 09-Exam/2023.

The recruitment covers 661 vacancies. However, the claimed 2026 Skill Test Exam Date could not be independently verified from the official UPSSSC website during the current check.

Therefore, the skill test date has not been marked as officially announced. Candidates should rely only on the official UPSSSC Notice Board for the skill test schedule, admit card and venue instructions.
